title: Non-root process binding port 80
statement: An image runs its server as USER 1000. You start it with `docker run --cap-drop ALL -p 8080:80 myapp` on the default bridge network, and the server binds 0.0.0.0:80 inside the container. What happens on a current Docker Engine?
choices: The bind fails with EACCES because ports below 1024 need CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
The bind succeeds because Docker sets net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=0 in the container's network namespace
The bind succeeds because -p grants CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE for the published port
Docker refuses to start the container because a non-root user cannot be combined with -p on a low port
